title: Moving loot and gear around
summary: Getting loot out of a level is a physical job in R.E.P.O.: the game defines boxed valuables, a rideable vehicle and a ladder, so distance and height are part of the problem.
body: Some loot arrives packaged in a box, which changes how easily it can be moved compared with an object you carry in your hands.
Height is a real obstacle rather than decoration, which is why the game provides a ladder as its own item.
A rideable vehicle exists to move things across ground, so a crew can choose between hands and hardware.
What this entry does not tell you: how much a vehicle carries, how fast it moves or how much the ladder costs. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: At least one valuable is packaged in a box you can move.
A rideable vehicle is its own item.
A ladder exists as its own item for reaching height.
The level decides which valuables are available to move at all.
